faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most.
faq.financingQ: Do you offer financing for buyers with less-than-perfect credit?
faq.financingA: Yes — we work with multiple lenders and have options for a wide range of credit situations. Apply for financing online and our team will follow up with the best offer we can find.
faq.tradeInQ: Can I trade in my current vehicle?
faq.tradeInA: Absolutely. Bring your vehicle by for a free appraisal, or mention it when you contact us and we'll walk you through the process.
faq.inspectedQ: Are your vehicles inspected before they're sold?
faq.inspectedA: Every vehicle on our lot passes a multi-point inspection and is reconditioned before it's listed for sale.
faq.warrantyA: Many of our vehicles come with a limited warranty, and extended warranty options are available at the time of purchase. Ask our sales team for details on a specific vehicle.
faq.testDriveQ: Can I schedule a test drive online?
faq.testDriveA: Yes — use the "Schedule Test Drive" button anywhere on the site, pick the vehicle and a time that works for you, and we'll confirm by phone or email.
faq.documentsQ: What documents do I need to buy a car?
faq.documentsA: You'll typically need a valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and proof of income if you're financing. Our team will let you know if anything else is needed for your situation.
